releases.notes:
Armature Client `0.9.5-preview` adds protocol 10 support for **Armature 2.0.0**.

- Open the Armature Client rendering settings with `/arm settings`.
- Use the server's personal camera movement intensity without changing the model pose.
- Hold the displayed pose when you switch back to an item while its equip animation is waiting to start.

Install the JAR for your exact Minecraft version with Fabric API. Builds are available for `1.21.8`, `1.21.9`, `1.21.10`, `1.21.11`, `26.1`, `26.1.1`, `26.1.2`, `26.2` and `26.3`. Servers using protocol 9 continue to render Armature models server-side.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod/compare/v0.9.4-preview...v0.9.5-preview)

releases.notes:
Fixes a resource reload failure that could leave Minecraft's window black at startup on 1.21.9 through 26.2, before connecting to an Armature server.

The armor renderer now passes the atlas definition ID (`minecraft:armor_trims`) to `AtlasManager`, instead of the old texture path (`minecraft:textures/atlas/armor_trims.png`). Minecraft 1.21.8 retains its existing atlas lookup. The fix does not require a server plugin update.

An added regression test compares Armature's armor atlas lookup with vanilla equipment rendering in each exact Minecraft target. It fails against the previous implementation and passes with this fix. All eight targets pass 76 headless tests, build their JARs, and compile gametests. Visual startup and Iris checks remain to be confirmed in game.

Choose the runtime JAR matching your exact Minecraft version. Source JARs are excluded; source code is available in the repository and GitHub source archives.

releases.notes:
Fixes interrupted or jumping unequip animation when a presentation moves between the current-item and outgoing-item channels.

The client now retains each protocol session's animation clock, transition, spring state and last viewport sample across channel moves and reclamation. Two profiles using the same model asset receive independent playback while sharing reference-counted uploaded textures. Clearing a channel still removes it immediately; only a subsequent ownership frame restores that session as an outgoing or reclaimed presentation. Options are applied with their following ownership frame, and superseded uploads cannot overwrite an already resolved presentation.

- Builds for Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
- Protocol remains 9. No plugin update is required for this fix.
- Includes the Sodium armor fix from 0.9.1-preview.
- Install only the runtime JAR matching your exact Minecraft version. Source JARs are excluded from release assets.

Validation: clean builds, headless tests, exact-version mixin bytecode checks and gametest-source compilation for all eight targets. Regression coverage compares migrated and uninterrupted animation at 30, 60, 144 and 240 FPS, exercises rapid same-asset profile changes and reclamation, checks shared texture lifetime and stale uploads, and checks legacy generic/rifle unequip plus modern raygun reverse-equip fixtures. Connected-client visual validation was not performed.

releases.notes:
Fixes Armature armor appearing tiny or misplaced when Sodium is installed.

Armor now emits its authored body-local mesh through Minecraft's equipment renderer. It no longer replaces the polygons of a temporary one-pixel cube, whose constructor geometry Sodium caches. This preserves the model's dimensions, bone transforms, rotated legacy faces and atlas UVs while keeping Minecraft's equipment textures, dyes, trims and glint.

- Builds for Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
- Protocol remains 9; no plugin update is required for this fix.
- Install only the runtime JAR matching your exact Minecraft version. Source JARs are excluded from release assets.

Validation: 71 headless tests passed for each of the eight targets, including equipment vertex/UV/color/lighting checks and exact-version mixin bytecode checks. The new regression test fails against the previous armor implementation. Gametest sources compiled for all targets; connected-client visual validation with Sodium/Iris was not performed.

releases.notes:
Adds version-specific Fabric builds for Minecraft **1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2**.

Download **one runtime JAR matching your exact Minecraft version**. Source code is available from the repository and GitHub's automatic source archives.

| Minecraft | Java | Optional Mod Menu |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.21.8 | 21+ | 15.x |
| 1.21.9 / 1.21.10 | 21+ | 16.x |
| 1.21.11 | 21+ | 17.x |
| 26.1 / 26.1.1 / 26.1.2 | 25+ | 18.x |
| 26.2 | 25+ | 20.x |

Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API for the selected Minecraft version are required. Client protocol remains **9**; use a compatible Armature server plugin.

The port adapts hand/model submission, armor and held-item rendering, movement interpolation, camera/projection hooks, networking and the Mod Menu screen. Authored animation and profile behavior stays shared, including legacy models, bone scale, neutral held-item conditions and server-renderer handoff. Minecraft 26.2 uses native rendering abstractions with no raw OpenGL calls.

**Validation:** 69 headless tests pass per target, including every configured mixin's signatures against that exact Minecraft JAR. Interactive client tests compile for all eight versions. The standalone source export also compiles independently.

**Preview:** connected-client visual tests, Iris shaderpack behavior and Vulkan rendering still need in-game verification. No Minecraft client or server was launched for this release.

See the [README](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod#readme) for installation, exact Fabric API versions and build instructions. SHA256SUMS.txt lists the hashes of the attached JARs. Source is MIT licensed and can be forked or integrated into a server-specific client mod.

releases.notes:
First public standalone release of Armature Client Mod.

## Install

- Minecraft **1.21.8**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**, Java **21+**.
- Install Fabric API for 1.21.8; Mod Menu **15.x** is optional.
- Put **armature-client-fabric-1.21.8-0.8.5-preview.jar** in your instance's `mods` folder.
- Source code is available from the repository and GitHub's automatic source archives.
- Your server needs a compatible Armature plugin using **protocol 9**, with the native backend and client rendering enabled. Protocol 8 plugins need updating before using this release.

## Open-source distribution

The mod is MIT licensed and can be used, modified, forked and integrated into server-specific client mods. Preserve the license and copyright notice. The source repository builds independently from the plugin and includes the exact shared Armature samplers/protocol used by this release.

- [Installation and build](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod#readme)
- [Integrating into another Fabric mod](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod/blob/main/docs/INTEGRATION.md)
- [Protocol contract](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Cryxow/ArmatureClientMod/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Validation

Standalone build, **68 headless tests**, client gametest compilation and GitHub build/release workflows passed. Minecraft/server gametests were not launched for this release; shaderpack and connected-client visual compatibility remain preview features requiring in-game verification.
